name: dsh-llm-session-header
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: attaches a stable per-conversation session header to model requests routed to configured providers. Header name is configurable, so one plugin serves OpenCode (x-opencode-session), Olla (X-Olla-Session-ID), and any other header-based affinity router.

scripts.test: node --test tests/test.mjs && node tests/integration.mjs && node tests/coexistence.mjs
